wholePhysicalScope: The four exact OpenStreetMap controls from the NSW base map bound the principal mosque. The exact Qualla photo distinguishes the high prayer-room roof and lower anteroom.
lodDetails: Four authored detail levels retain the mapped mosque footprint, prayer room and anteroom. Close views add corrugation profile, timber doors, windows and the washing channel.
limitations: The red cladding and main hipped roof follow the exact published photo. The approach channel, anteroom section and windows partly obscured by vegetation are approximate.
The separate relocated West Camel Camp mosque, museum exhibits, landscaping, and vegetation are outside the principal building scope.
